meta.note: One row per USER message. History is anonymized (role user/assistant, text only) so the model can't cheat off past agent labels. 'label' is SILVER (the LLM router's pick, from metadata.agent) — build a human-labeled gold subset separately. 'previous_agent' is a SEPARATE silver feature (prior turn's label, name-normalized, null on turn 1) for the with/without ablation; it is NOT inside history. 'available_agents' is the channel-scoped snapshot AS OF decision time; descriptions live in agent_catalog.

agent_catalog.GreetAgent: Opening greetings only: hi, hello, hey, good morning. Nothing else.
agent_catalog.ChitChatAgent: Closings/acknowledgements after resolution: ok, thanks, bye, that's all.
agent_catalog.OrderTrackingAgent: Order status, tracking, delivery ETA/TAT. Not returns, refunds, or cancellations.
agent_catalog.OrderCancellationAgent: Cancelling an order, or asking why an order was cancelled. Not refunds or returns.
agent_catalog.KnowledgeBaseAgent: Policies, FAQs, shipping/TAT, COD availability, store info, and GENERAL discounts/coupons not tied to a specific product.
agent_catalog.ShoppingAgent: Product discovery, price, details, ingredients, usage, purity/authenticity, product-specific discounts, buying/checkout.
agent_catalog.HandoffAgent: Explicit request for a human agent; or address/contact changes; or payment/order-placement problems.
agent_catalog.BulkEnquiryAgent: Bulk, wholesale, corporate, or large-quantity order enquiries.
